title: Synthetic infrastructure smoke: exact public B0 identity interface
coverage_gap: Validate candidate construction, frozen interface compatibility, and immutable submission plumbing only. The supplied fixture is synthetic; no robot coverage gap or empirical policy improvement is asserted.
reusable_regularity: Identity preservation of the complete normalized observation history and native action channels. No scientific bias, learned encoder, stage model, auxiliary head, or additional support-fit statistics are introduced.
dependencies_preserved: Both causal history observations and every synthetic field at indices [0,4) pass to the common DP without reordering, aggregation, or removal.
The host-owned normalization remains based only on current D_N obs[0:T], with population standard deviation floor 0.001.
All four action channels keep their native ordering and values through inherited identity encode_actions and decode_actions.
Exactly one unmodified common DP is registered as self.dp, with per-observation condition_dim equal to common_spec.observation_schema.raw_dim and default diffusion_action_dim 4.
The common action epsilon loss retains weight 1 and denominator mask.sum()*4. No auxiliary losses or diffusion channels are added.
The host retains ownership of sampling randomness, action clipping, history length two, horizon sixteen, and execution prefix four.
evidence_refs: bundle.json: synthetic=true; the only listed evidence file is task_materials.json, with no demonstration images.
task_materials.json: infrastructure-smoke; four unitless synthetic observation fields at slice [0,4); four synthetic action channels and no robot trajectory.
PUBLIC_CONTRACT.md: B0 public semantics specify identity conditioning, factory(raw_dim), identity action mappings, and no additional losses.
contracts.py: CandidateDesign supplies identity encode/decode and diffusion targets, direct common-DP denoising, empty training targets, no extra loss, and empty deployment state.
learning.py: common host provides normalization, causal context, shape requirements, fixed action loss, and zero-update interface validation.
expected_failure_signature: An implementation mismatch would be falsified by condition returning anything other than the unchanged [B,2,4] history, or by action encode/decode changing native values.
Extra candidate parameters, more than one factory call, auxiliary loss, altered action dimensions, or inference dependence on future targets would violate the intended B0 equivalence.
No task-success failure signature can be inferred from a synthetic interface fixture; no performance prediction is made.
required_runtime_fields: common_spec.observation_schema.raw_dim, used during build_modules; equals 4 in this fixture.
causal_history [B,2,4], the host-normalized values of the complete synthetic source field obs[...,0:4].
The public causal_context argument is accepted but not read; raw_history and raw_current are not additional conditioning inputs for this identity design.
Native or encoded action tensors [B,16,4] for the inherited identity action mappings, and the standard host-provided noisy actions, timesteps, and conditioning for denoising.
action_frame_semantics: Exact identity in the fixture's native four-channel synthetic action coordinates. The fixture specifies no robot trajectory or physical world/tool frame. There is no translation, rotation, scaling, clipping, or channel reinterpretation in candidate code; executor clipping remains host-only.
support_fit_state: No candidate-specific support fitting or deployment state; inherited state is {}. Host common normalization is unchanged.
change_summary: Initial smoke implementation, not a scientific prior-search candidate. Subclass the frozen CandidateDesign, implement only build_modules and identity condition, and inherit the public B0-compatible defaults. Empty configuration introduces no tunable design choices. No structural repairs or measured performance claims at authoring.
